title: The bird on the ramp
logline: The bird on Gully's plank ramp in June, a month after the seawall, in the middle of a Sunday's foot traffic, and nobody stepping on it or around it. The pup looking at it from the dock. Not explained.

panels.composition: The plank ramp at the shack's door with the small rainbow bird standing on it, boots passing on the dock either side, a small three-legged dog sitting on the planks watching it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird standing on a plank ramp at a bait shack's door with boots passing on the dock either side and a small three-legged dog sitting watching it, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: On the ramp. Nobody steps around it.
